## How the SOFAR Channel Carries Distant Whale Calls

The SOFAR channel is a naturally occurring pathway in the ocean through which low-frequency sound can travel long distances. As sound waves bend up and down through the channel, they can remain detectable far from their source.

A hydrophone positioned near the channel’s axis can detect distant sounds, including whale calls. In some instances, low-frequency sound can travel across entire ocean basins, helping explain how calls from far away can be heard.
